translations.web: He found a fresh jawbone of a donkey, put out his hand, took it, and struck a thousand men with it.
translations.bsb: He found the fresh jawbone of a donkey, reached out his hand and took it, and struck down a thousand men.
translations.kjv: And he found a new jawbone of an ass, and put forth his hand, and took it, and slew a thousand men
translations.asv: And he found a fresh jawbone of an ass, and put forth his hand, and took it, and smote a thousand men therewith.
